utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the eighth of May. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the silent Teams briefing again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, we've got you. Bit tinny, but that might just be the office speakers.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Morning. Anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, those last few minutes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Saw the result. Glad I didn't stay up for it, by the sound of you.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Ninety minutes of my life I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'm more interested in the weekend weather. Had plans for a barbecue, now it looks like standing under an umbrella with a sausage.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So, a normal British barbecue.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: At least there's the charity bake sale on Friday. Today, I mean. Still mentally on Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It's been that sort of week. Cake sounds about right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the catering meeting. Let's do the finished stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the site water yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, closed rather than another job on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the GT2 inlet valve last night. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, the inlet valve repair's complete. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I tested the GT2 bearing yesterday and it's all fine now, too. That check's closed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: One observation, though. Heard a slight rattle from the Line 3 Chiller. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just an observation, then, not a maintenance job coming out of this?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Not asking for any work on it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing: saw the pressure on the WHB dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. Just reporting what I saw, no action from that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the 11kV board is still waiting on parts. Nothing we can do until they arrive, so that's blocked, not something we can progress today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Let's keep the blocked stuff separate from what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Please. Otherwise the list looks twice as long and half of it's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On purchasing, could you chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor, Fiona? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that one. I haven't got the purchasing access to follow it through properly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Jamie, can you take that instead—chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor? Still no rush.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the turbine one compressor. That's with me instead.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Thanks. Better than me bouncing it straight back to Stores anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no rush, understood. Not treating it as an urgent chase.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're on that, we were going to replace the belt on the turbine one compressor, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. Not work for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, belt replacement out of today's scope. The purchase order chase is separate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll book a contractor to look at the GT2 this morning. No rush on that, just a routine booking.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the booking this morning, not saying the contractor's coming this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll make the booking this morning; we're not agreeing an attendance time here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it, Sarah. Yours, and not an urgent call-out.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine. Just didn't want that muddled with the inlet valve repair I've already finished.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, definitely separate.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, you both came through together for a second. I've got it now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, if you've got a spare minute, could you send the shift handover report round by Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. It's an if-you've-got-a-spare-minute one, not something to drop everything for.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Low-key, but by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, was that me making the echo?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Think so. It's gone now. Teams keeping us humble.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Also, I'll inspect the turbine two water valve for leaks this afternoon. That one's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Grace Liu on the turbine two water valve inspection this afternoon, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do the leak inspection. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Clear. Turbine two water valve, separate from the site water testing that's already done.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly, different item.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, easy to merge those in your head when everything's got water or turbine in the name.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last one. David Whitfield, could you write up the near miss at the palletizer for tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll write up the near miss at the palletizer. Tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's Saturday, just saying it out loud so my brain doesn't turn it into Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, tomorrow at 9:30 is the deadline.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That all sounds clear. And the chiller rattle and WHB pressure dip are observations only.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Neither is a new job from this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And no magic progress on the 11kV board while the parts aren't here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Would be nice if saying it on Teams made the parts appear.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Usually just makes another notification appear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Finished work stays closed, blocked work stays separate. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers. Glad we've established what day it is, at least.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Friday. Definitely Friday. See you in a bit.
